info.title: Atom CMS browser API
info.description: Versioned browser API available in full and headless modes. All authentication operations use the existing cookie session. Requests must send Accept: application/json; unsafe requests require X-XSRF-TOKEN. Auth endpoints keep their native Fortify/Atom response shape. Public v1 data is allowlisted; monetary response amounts are integer minor units. Dynamic hotel validation rules and emulator capability gates remain server authoritative.
